name: playwright-automation-framework
description: No-code/low-code end-to-end test automation platform powered by Playwright

scripts.dev: concurrently -n backend,frontend -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --workspace=backend" "npm run dev --workspace=frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --workspace=backend && npm install --workspace=frontend
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=backend && npm run build --workspace=frontend
scripts.setup:browsers: cd backend && npx playwright install chromium firefox webkit
